mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, model_key, model_name, category_name, biz_type, form_type, form_route, latest_version, status, remark, process_config, source_model_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND model_key = #{modelKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE model_key = #{modelKey} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY tenant_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE model_key = #{modelKey} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (
tenant_id = #{preferTenantId} OR tenant_id = '0'
tenant_id = '0'
) ORDER BY CASE WHEN tenant_id = #{preferTenantId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id = '0') ORDER BY CASE WHEN tenant_id = #{tenantId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM wf_model WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND tenant_id = '0' AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.tenant_id, m.model_key, m.model_name, m.category_name, m.biz_type, m.form_type, m.form_route, m.latest_version, m.status, m.remark, m.process_config, m.source_model_id, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_at, m.deleted FROM wf_model m INNER JOIN wf_biz_binding_policy p ON p.biz_type = m.biz_type AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id = '0' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0' AND p.binding_mode IN ('tenant_required', 'tenant_preferred') ORDER BY m.biz_type ASC, m.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM wf_model
ORDER BY tenant_id ASC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(model_key, ' — ', model_name) AS label, model_key AS modelKey, biz_type AS bizType FROM wf_model WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND ( tenant_id = #{scopeTenantId} OR tenant_id = '0' ) ORDER BY tenant_id ASC, model_key ASC
